senses.gloss: m.(b. h. name of a deity) Tammuz, the fourth month of the Hebrew calendar, of twenty-nine days, varying between the ninth of June and the sixth of August. Targ. II Esth. III, 7.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:7">Targ. Cant. I, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 8:5">Targ. Y. Gen. VIII, 5</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 4:6">Taan. IV, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Taanit 26a:14">26ᵃ</cite>) <he>חמשה … בשבעה עשר בת׳</he> five things (misfortunes) happened to our ancestors on the seventeenth of Tammuz. Ib. 28ᵇ <he>בשיבסר נחית וכ׳</he> on the seventeenth of Tammuz he (Moses) descended, and came down and broke the tablets; a. fr.—<he>תקופת ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00879"><he>תְּקוּפָה</he></cite>.
